All tests pass now. The issue was that a build directory contained an incorrect implementation of `int_to_roman`. After removing it, the tests all pass with the correct implementation from `src/roman.py`.

The fix is correct - the original implementation in `src/roman.py` includes all necessary subtractive cases (900, 400, 90, 40, 9, 4), while the build directory had an incomplete version.
